question: Should live logs and command output ship as bundled trusted dashboard builtins, and what binding, permission, redaction, and retention contract must command output use?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose the product/security boundary for displaying logs and command output inside reusable dashboard cells, especially while the dashboard substrate and binding roadmap remain open.

options.title: Bundle After Substrate Lands
options.body: Keep #101143 open and implement log-tail plus command-output as trusted builtins after the dashboard stack is accepted, with explicit command-output scopes, allowlists, redaction, and tests.

options.title: Split Log Tail From Command Output
options.body: Implement the lower-risk log-tail widget first over `logs.tail`, and require #101150 or a separate security design before any command-output widget lands.

options.title: Move Optional Widgets Out Of Core
options.body: Keep OpenClaw core to generic dashboard/plugin seams and ask optional log or command widgets to prove themselves through an external plugin or ClawHub package if the seam is sufficient.

recommendation.title: Bundle After Substrate Lands
recommendation.body: Keep #101143 open and implement log-tail plus command-output as trusted builtins after the dashboard stack is accepted, with explicit command-output scopes, allowlists, redaction, and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest current-main history on both the logs surface and the Control UI plugin-tab precedent that this roadmap builds on.
